items.title: 9.3.4 Steps to Pitching Your Idea (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3.4 (PDF 215-216), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

items: Masle se shuru karein (Start with the Problem): pehle woh masla batayein jo aap ka business idea hal karega. Maslan: "Hamare mohalle mein bohat log sehatmand khana chahte hain, lekin taza juice ke zyada options nahi hain."

Apna hal pesh karein (Introduce Your Solution): phir batayein ke aap ka karobar yeh masla kaise hal karega. Maslan: "Hamari juice shop local (maqami) phalon se bane alag alag taza, sehatmand juice degi."

Batayein ke yeh unique (sab se alag) kyun hai (Explain Why It's Unique): aap ka idea doosre options se mukhtalif ya behtar kyun hai? Maslan: "Doosri dukanon ke ulat hum kam qeemat par tawajjo denge aur local kisanon se phal khareed kar un ki madad karenge."

Apne sunne walon ko jaanein (Know Your Audience): sochein ke aap kis ke saamne pitch kar rahe hain. Potential customers hon to batayein ke unhein aap ke juice kyun pasand aayenge. Investors hon to batayein ke dukaan paisa kaise kamayegi.

Sawalon ke liye tayyar rahein (Be Prepared to Answer Questions): pitch ke baad log sawal pooch sakte hain. Zyada detail batane ke liye tayyar rahein, jaise juice ki qeemat kya hogi ya dukaan kahan hogi.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche paanch numbered dabbe, teeron se jure: 1. Masla (problem): taza juice ke mauqe kam hain. 2. Hal (solution): local phalon ke taza juice. 3. Unique kyun (sab se alag): sasta, kisanon ki madad. 4. Audience (sunne wale): gahak ke liye kyun pasand, investor ke liye profit. 5. Sawalon ke liye tayyar: qeemat, jagah, tafseel.
blocks.caption: Pitch ke paanch qadam, juice shop ki misal ke saath (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Misal: farz karein aap dekhte hain ke aap ke shehar ke bohat se chhote karobaron, jaise local dukanon ya restaurants, ki website nahi hai. Aap faisla karte hain ke web development service ka idea pitch karenge jo in karobaron ko online lane mein madad de.
Aap ki pitch kuch is tarah ho sakti hai:

items: Masla (Problem): "Hamare shehar ke bohat se chhote karobar website na hone ki wajah se customers nahi la pate."
Hal (Solution): "Main web development service shuru karunga jo in karobaron ke liye saadi aur sasti websites banayegi."

Unique Selling Point (woh khoobi jo sirf aap mein hai): "Hamari service khaas taur par chhote karobaron ke liye banayi gayi hogi, aasan designs aur local language (apni maqami zaban) ki sahoolat ke saath."

Target Audience (jin tak pohanchna hai): "Hamare target customers local dukaandar aur restaurant managers hain jo online presence (internet par nazar aane) se zyada customers tak pohanchna chahte hain."

blocks.prompt: Achhi business pitch ke aham hisse kya hain, aur pitch kaise tayyar karte hain (long question 4)?
blocks.explanation: Hisse: saaf masla, aap ka hal, aap ka idea unique kyun hai, sunne wale kaun hain, aur investors ke liye paisa kaise banega. Tayyari: market aur competitors par research; isi order mein chhota sa script; sunne walon ke mutabiq baat badalna; saade visuals ya numbers; itni mashq ke pitch saaf ho aur waqt ke andar khatam ho; aur aane wale sawalon (qeemat, jagah, kharche) ke jawab pehle se tayyar.

items: Pitch ke paanch qadam: masla, hal, unique kyun, sunne wale kaun, sawalon ki tayyari.
